actions: OPEN INPUT PRES-IN AUTH-IN OUTPUT PRES-OUT REPORT-OUT
PERFORM MATCH-NEXT UNTIL WS-PRES-KEY = HIGH-VALUES AND WS-AUTH-KEY = HIGH-VALUES

rules.sentence: When `WS-NOT-MATCHED` is more than zero, it opens `PRES-IN` and `AUTH-IN` for input and `PRES-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; performs `READ-PRESENTMENT`; performs `READ-AUTHORIZATION`; performs `MATCH-NEXT` until `WS-PRES-KEY` is high values and `WS-AUTH-KEY` is high values; performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `PRES-IN`, `AUTH-IN`, `PRES-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.

When `WS-NOT-MATCHED` is at most zero, it opens `PRES-IN` and `AUTH-IN` for input and `PRES-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; performs `READ-PRESENTMENT`; performs `READ-AUTHORIZATION`; performs `MATCH-NEXT` until `WS-PRES-KEY` is high values and `WS-AUTH-KEY` is high values; performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `PRES-IN`, `AUTH-IN`, `PRES-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.

conditions: READ PRES-IN INTO PRES-RECORD AT END

rules.sentence: When reading `PRES-IN` finds no more records, it reads `PRES-IN` into `PRES-RECORD` and sets `WS-PRES-KEY` to high values.
When reading `PRES-IN` finds a record, it reads `PRES-IN` into `PRES-RECORD` and sets `WS-PRES-KEY` to `PS-AUTH-CODE`.
When reading `AUTH-IN` finds no more records, it reads `AUTH-IN`, sets `WS-AUTH-KEY` to high values, and sets `WS-AUTH-CLAIMED` to `'N'`.
When reading `AUTH-IN` finds a record, it reads `AUTH-IN`, sets `WS-AUTH-KEY` to `AL-AUTH-CODE`, and sets `WS-AUTH-CLAIMED` to `'N'`.
When `WS-PRES-KEY` is less than `WS-AUTH-KEY`, it sets `PS-MATCH` to `PS-NO-AUTH`, performs `WRITE-PRESENTMENT`, and performs `READ-PRESENTMENT`.

When `WS-PRES-KEY` is at least `WS-AUTH-KEY`, `WS-PRES-KEY` is more than `WS-AUTH-KEY`, and `WS-AUTH-CLAIMED` is not `'Y'` (not `AUTH-CLAIMED`), it adds 1 to `WS-LAPSED` and performs `READ-AUTHORIZATION`.
When `WS-PRES-KEY` is at least `WS-AUTH-KEY`, `WS-PRES-KEY` is more than `WS-AUTH-KEY`, and `WS-AUTH-CLAIMED` is `'Y'` (`AUTH-CLAIMED`), it performs `READ-AUTHORIZATION`.

When `WS-PRES-KEY` is at least `WS-AUTH-KEY` and `WS-PRES-KEY` is at most `WS-AUTH-KEY`, it performs `MARK-PRESENTMENT`, sets `WS-AUTH-CLAIMED` to `AUTH-CLAIMED`, performs `WRITE-PRESENTMENT`, and performs `READ-PRESENTMENT`.
When `AL-DECISION` is not `'D'` (not `AL-DECLINED`) and `PS-AMOUNT` is more than `AL-AMOUNT * TOLERANCE`, it sets `PS-MATCH` to `PS-OVER-AUTH`.
When `AL-DECISION` is not `'D'` (not `AL-DECLINED`) and `PS-AMOUNT` is at most `AL-AMOUNT * TOLERANCE`, it sets `PS-MATCH` to `PS-MATCHED`.
When `PS-MATCH` is `'M'` (`PS-MATCHED`), it writes `PRES-RECORD` and adds 1 to `WS-MATCHED`.
When `PS-MATCH` is not `'M'` (not `PS-MATCHED`), it writes `PRES-RECORD` and adds 1 to `WS-NOT-MATCHED`.
